name: Laid-off London product manager with an existing application pipeline

context.employment_state: Recently laid off; 40 applications already tracked in a spreadsheet
context.company_awareness: Broad role-led search across SaaS employers; some known names but no fixed shortlist

trigger: Prepares for an interview and finds recruiter details and round-specific notes scattered across spreadsheet cells and documents.

searches_run.query: product manager B2B SaaS jobs London
searches_run.observation: Retrieval surfaced a dedicated LinkedIn category page for B2B SaaS product manager jobs in London; direct opening confirmed the page. Its aggregate count is not treated as a verified number of fitting vacancies.

searches_run.query: job application tracker import spreadsheet interview notes
searches_run.observation: Results mixed downloadable spreadsheet templates, tracker vendors and a small open-source tracker. Direct inspection of JobDrop's README documented spreadsheet import, field mapping, notes and export claims; the software was not executed or audited.

sources.title: Product Manager SaaS B2B Jobs London — LinkedIn
sources.supports: Retrieved and opened category page matches the role-sector-location combination; no ranking or accurate fitting-vacancy total is inferred.

sources.title: JobDrop Tracker — GitHub repository
sources.supports: Direct README inspection documents XLSX/CSV field-mapped import, notes, status history and export. These are publisher claims, not tested capabilities or a recommendation.

sources.title: CareerCircle Job Application Tracker
sources.supports: Retrieved template page describes interview-round organization and spreadsheet import instructions, supporting spreadsheets as a visible alternative in the result set.

best_entry_page.primary_query: job application tracker spreadsheet vs app
best_entry_page.promise: Explain when a spreadsheet remains useful and demonstrate Job Seek's interview notes and application stages for jobs indexed by Job Seek, with clear migration limits.
best_entry_page.cta: Try tracking a Job Seek role and compare the workflow
proof_needed: Prominent disclosure that arbitrary external-job import is not demonstrated
Accurate demo of interview notes and stage updates
Keep existing sheet rather than suggest destructive migration
Verify free tracker scope and limits
No claim to import all 40 applications
A useful comparison even for people who stay with their spreadsheet
New indexable comparison page; account/search pages remain noindex

conversion_objections: Can I import my forty applications without retyping?
Will this track roles from recruiters and other boards?
I cannot have two conflicting versions of my interview history.
How do I retrieve or export my notes later?
Will a product manager search keep showing product marketing, project management or jobs requiring a different domain?
Does description matching help enough to justify paying during unemployment?

avoid_targeting.query: import Excel job applications into Job Seek
avoid_targeting.reason: Spreadsheet import and arbitrary external application records are not demonstrated.

avoid_targeting.query: best recruiter ATS for product managers
avoid_targeting.reason: This is a candidate workflow, not employer applicant management.

avoid_targeting.query: guaranteed B2B SaaS product manager interviews
avoid_targeting.reason: No interview outcome can be promised.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I already have forty applications recorded, so your tracker has to respect the work I have done. I would try better notes for a new role, but I will not rebuild my entire search just to see whether the app helps.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona, two search queries, two direct opens. Other searches are hypotheses. No tested competitor feature, search volume or conversion conclusion. The product can track indexed postings; external/manual import is unproven and materially limits the spreadsheet-replacement pitch. B2B/domain fit needs description evidence rather than title matching alone.

search_journey.fit_reason: Role and location filtering match if coverage is sufficient.
